objective.name: Canonical Population / Data Quality / Remove 504
canonical_population_definition: worker RUT is present and valid
normalized bed key exists in the current operational bed inventory
objective.single_population_rule: Occupancy, workforce/dotacion and MOD/MOI must consume the same canonical valid lodged-worker population.

operational_universe_dependency.source: bed_inventory produced by the approved R1 operational-universe semantics
operational_universe_dependency.duplicate_policy: Any duplicate operational bed key is CONFLICT.
operational_universe_dependency.worker_creation_policy: Only EN TURNO rows create workers during import.

quality_semantics.invalid_rut: Worker is excluded from canonical population and remains reportable as a quality issue.
quality_semantics.incomplete_location: Worker is excluded from canonical population and remains reportable as a quality issue.
quality_semantics.missing_inventory_bed: Worker is excluded from canonical population and remains reportable as a quality issue.
quality_semantics.inventory_reference: No fixed business bed-count constant may be used as an expected inventory denominator. The current operational inventory count may be displayed directly. A gap against an expected inventory may only exist if an explicit authoritative reference is provided; it must never fall back to 504.
quality_semantics.population_consistency: Quality diagnostics may explain exclusions, but operational KPIs must use only canonical valid lodged workers.

tests.name: canonical-valid-worker
tests.requirement: A worker is canonical only when RUT is valid, location is complete and the normalized bed key exists in operational inventory.

tests.name: invalid-rut-excluded
tests.requirement: Invalid RUT workers are excluded from canonical occupancy/workforce/MOD-MOI while remaining visible to quality diagnostics.

tests.name: incomplete-location-excluded
tests.requirement: Workers missing module, room or bed are excluded from canonical population.

tests.name: missing-inventory-bed-excluded
tests.requirement: Workers whose complete bed key does not exist in operational inventory are excluded from canonical population.

tests.name: occupancy-uses-canonical-population
tests.requirement: occupiedWorkers, fastOccupiedWorkers and physical occupancy worker counts derive from canonical valid lodged workers.

tests.name: workforce-mod-moi-uses-canonical-population
tests.requirement: Workforce/dotacion and CampWorkforceMODMOI totals use the same canonical population and cannot count a worker rejected by R2-U02, R2-U03 or R2-U04.

tests.name: remove-business-504
tests.requirement: No active business logic may use 504 as expected bed inventory. EXPECTED_BEDS=504 and equivalent fixed inventory assumptions are forbidden.

tests.name: preserve-http-504
tests.requirement: HTTP status 504 Gateway Timeout remains retryable in resilience networking logic.

tests.name: quality-no-false-fixed-gap
tests.requirement: Base quality cannot become REVISAR solely because operational inventory differs from 504. Inventory presentation/quality must use current operational inventory or an explicit authoritative reference.

tests.name: scope-guard
tests.requirement: R2 must not intentionally change Capacity V1 fallback semantics, reservations, movements, snapshot provenance or closure semantics.

capacity_v1.note: Existing 132/daily_capacity_default fallback behavior is observed technical debt but is not modified by R2.

http_504.instruction: Do not remove HTTP 504 from RETRYABLE_STATUS.

mod_moi_divergence.finding: assigned() currently requires only non-empty module, room and bed; it does not itself prove valid RUT or existence in operational inventory.
